description: This file contains shell script code related to platform-specific image handling and upgrade procedures for a network device firmware management system. It includes functions for identifying firmware images, verifying compatibility, extracting partitions, and performing upgrades tailored to different hardware and firmware formats.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte magic value from a file at a specified offset in bytes.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 4-byte long value from a file at a specified offset in bytes.

methods.name: platform_flash_type
methods.description: Determines whether the device uses 'serial' or 'nand' flash based on /proc/mtd entries.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected firmware image name based on the device's board name.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware format and board ID by analyzing magic numbers and headers in the firmware image.

methods.name: platform_other_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image against device expectations and format.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is compatible with the device, with special handling for certain models.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_trx
methods.description: Performs an upgrade on NAND devices using TRX images by extracting and flashing partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_seamaseal
methods.description: Performs an upgrade on NAND devices using Seama seal images, extracting UBI partitions.

methods.name: platform_img_from_safeloader
methods.description: Extracts the OS image and filesystem from a SafeLoader image package.

methods.name: platform_other_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines the image format and performs the appropriate upgrade process.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that calls format-specific upgrade routines based on the board.
